# Azure OpenAI (Foundry classic) What's New — captured 2026-08-07
Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/whats-new
(canonical now /azure/foundry-classic/openai/whats-new; ms.date 2025-12-30, updated_at 2026-06-05)

Page still tops at **May 2026** — GPT Realtime 2.0 (preview) overview, GPT Realtime Translate,
GPT Realtime Whisper concept articles. No June, July or August 2026 sections.
Below that: Feb 2026 gpt-realtime-1.5 / gpt-audio-1.5; Dec 2025 GPT-image-1.5, ASR/realtime-mini/TTS
updates; Oct 2025 Realtime SIP, gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize, gpt-image-1-mini, PII detection filter.

Foundry docs hub (/azure/foundry/, ms.date 2026-06-16, updated_at 2026-06-26) unchanged: Foundry
Models, Foundry Agent Service, Foundry IQ, Foundry Tools, Observability & evaluation (incl. AI Red
Teaming Agent preview), Foundry Control Plane, Foundry Local, Foundry MCP Server, Foundry Skill.

API reference: control plane latest preview 2025-07-01-preview / GA 2025-06-01; data plane v1 preview
and v1 GA. Unchanged.

Updated: 2026-08-07 — Azure AI Foundry itself contributed nothing new this scan. NOTE the cross-
platform movement instead: Copilot Studio agents can now attach a **Foundry IQ** knowledge base
(reported this scan), and **Claude Opus 5** is now available in Microsoft Foundry (reported this scan).
